facts.text: Glasshaven is a hidden coastal realm concealed behind the shimmering Mistwall; invited eleven-year-olds enter through the Fog Arch on Platform Zero or hidden coastal brass-hinged doors.

Lanternhold Academy sits on a sea-cliff island divided into four connected zones: The Brass Terraces (Path of Spark), The Living Cloister (Path of Roots), The Star Spire (Path of Stars), and The Crossroads Court around the Threefold Lantern.
All eleven-year-old first-years begin in First-Term Foundations studying all three disciplines before specializing by ringing the Choosing Bell at the Mid-Term Crossing.

The Path of Spark (Engineering and Science, led by Master Jorge) channels Glimmer through gears, lenses, springs, and blueprints; it is the most reliable Path through trial and error, and its milder dark side is Rustwork.

The Path of Roots (Nature, led by Master Marissa) partners with Breath across weather, plants, and animals through balance and teamwork; it refuses domination, and its milder dark side is Thornwork or Blight.

The Path of Stars (Pure Magic, led by Master Peter) channels raw Aether via willpower and a focus such as a Star-Pin; it is the strongest yet hardest-to-control Path, and its dangerous dark side is Hollow Magic (ink-black smoke with pale violet edges that eats warmth, sound, light, and memory).

Clara (eleven at arrival) joins the Path of Stars, begins Book 1 with no personal relationship with Master Jorge or Master Marissa, and builds deep trust with both across Book 1 while keeping friendships across all three Paths.

Master Jorge leads the Path of Spark (copper goggles, rolled sleeves, leather tool apron); Master Marissa leads the Path of Roots (braided chestnut hair with green cord, moss-green cloak, silver Cloud-Owl companion).

Master Peter, Leader Teacher of the Path of Stars, is a big, Black, strong, broad-shouldered man in his early forties with close-cropped hair, silver at the temples, kind crinkled eyes, a warm booming laugh, a midnight-indigo coat with silver clasps, and a carved wooden lantern-staff. He looks genuinely trustworthy.

AUTHOR SECRET (DO NOT REVEAL BEFORE BOOK 5): Master Peter secretly serves the Quiet Crown faction and uses his warm, trustworthy position as Head of the Path of Stars to gather the Threefold Keys and unseal the Heart-Vault across Books 1 to 5.

Magical creatures of Glasshaven include Emberfoxes (lantern-tailed cinnamon foxes), Cloud-Owls (storm-sensing mist owls), Mossbacks (fern-shelled dog-sized turtles), Shadow-Moths (sound-stealing dark moths), and Stone Hounds (carved spire guardians woken by dark magic).
The Whispering Bell above the Star Spire rings silently inside Star-students' minds whenever Hollow Magic touches the island.
The Heart-Vault beneath Lanternhold seals away the ancient Quiet Crown behind three locks: the Brass Key, the Living Wood Key, and the Star-Glass Key.

Glasshaven cast names are grounded and kid-friendly (Clara, Jorge, Marissa, Peter, Leo, Maya, Sam, Nora, Owen) and this universe is completely original with zero continuity ties to other studio universes.
